source: John's rubric for prj01 minutes (Learning AI-L07, 26/11/2026) and its coaching notes: numbered topics, each with a summary of the discussion and its actions (even if none), every point backed by a real quote; faithfulness checked on its own.

topic.summary: One to four points that say what was discussed and where it landed, in plain words.
topic.actions: Every action agreed in this topic: what, who owns it (as named in the meeting), and when, if a date was said. Write none when the topic agreed no action.

rules: Write only what was said in the meeting. No advice, no guesses, no facts from outside the transcript.
Group the meeting into numbered topics in the order they were discussed; small talk and technical trouble are not topics.
Every summary point and every action carries at least one quote: words copied exactly from one transcript line, with that line's number.
A quote is a short exact span (at most 40 words) from a single line. Do not join lines, fix spelling or change words inside a quote.
Owners and dates are written as people said them; when no owner or date was said, leave it empty instead of guessing.
If a later part of the meeting changes an earlier point, the topic states where it landed and quotes the line that settled it.
If the transcript mentions another project, keep it only when it was discussed for this project, and say which project it was.
